correctness.rationale: PASS: Both 16-vertex graphs have adjacency spectrum 6^1 2^6 (-2)^9 from A^2=4I+2J. For 3 color classes with sizes n_c, monochromatic edge count B>=sum n_c^2/4-16>=5.5, so integer B>=6. A Shrikhande coloring attains six; the rook row/column eight edge-disjoint K4 cliques force B>=8 and a witness attains eight. Independent C++ subset-partition enumeration visited exactly 3^16=43046721 labeled states for EACH graph, with all 17 favored-color occupancy minima and degeneracies reproduced exactly, including the zero-field totals 288 versus 90936. Convex hull of (k,m_{G,k}) gives field transitions rook (-2,0,4,6), Shrikhande (-5/2,0,1,7/2,9/2,6); collinear sectors included in critical degeneracies. This finite census is exhaustive, not sampling.
